jobs.description:
I need a short, impactful PowerPoint deck that can hold a classroom’s attention from the first slide to the last. The focus is purely on PPT creation for an educational lecture, and I expect the finished file to run somewhere between one and ten slides.

Here’s what will make this project a success:  
• A clean, visually consistent theme that supports learning rather than distracts from it.  
• Clear hierarchy of text, tasteful use of icons or imagery, and a color palette that remains accessible when projected.  
• Smooth, purposeful slide transitions—no flashy animation for animation’s sake.
